scope: Deterministically rank approved cover-letter career facts by exact normalized token overlap with posting skills and responsibilities; retain source order for ties.

tests.details: 9 tests passed, including strongest-overlap-first, stable tie order, unapproved/unsourced/low-confidence no-match fail-closed behavior, and ranked generation-history readback from reopened SQLite storage.

preserved_invariants: Only verified, user-approved, sufficiently confident, sourced facts with stable fact IDs are eligible.
Fact wording, job snapshot, preview validation, and review/download gates remain intact.
No employer context is inferred or invented; existing source-listed company identity behavior is unchanged.
limitations: This is a bounded improvement and does not satisfy the full MJ-REQ-100 acceptance contract, including verified company context.
Tests use synthetic fixture data and local SQLite only.
Hosted checks, manual browser review, and real application submission were not run; submission remains off.
